correctness.rationale: For every m,n>=3 and d>=1, the universal cover consists of weighted trivalent skeleton edges with lengths m,m,d at one type of hub and n,n,d at the other. The intrinsic rooted types separate hub, segment, and position orbits except when m=n=d; on that diagonal the subdivided regular trivalent universal cover loses finite edge-bridge status. The finite automorphism group verifies the three displayed orbit-count formulas. Separate exact tests run on 2,760 parameter choices, with direct automorphism enumeration on 70. The symbolic proof covers all integers, not merely the experiments.
